verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents recurring, autonomous background work. Connectors sync data automatically, handling schema changes and incremental syncs, at frequencies down to 1-minute syncs, and transformations run automatically after syncs or on a set schedule. This is a recurring schedule, not a one-off action, but it is limited to data-pipeline syncs and transformations rather than general automations a user defines. missing for 10: general-purpose or agent-driven background automations beyond data syncs and transformations, documentation of scheduling configuration depth (custom triggers, conditional workflows), and independent hands-on corroboration of the autonomous scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Transformations are automatically executed after connection syncs or on a set schedule.
Each connector handles schema changes, API updates, and incremental syncs automatically — no data pipelines to maintain.
